items.text: Was proud to join @POTUS at the White House for this announcement. Following my breast cancer diagnosis last year, I know firsthand the importance of preventive care. This relaunch is a step forward as we keep pushing for advancements in prevention, diagnosis, & treatment.

Since 2005, about 2200 local newspapers across the U.S. have closed. But while paper revenues have plummeted, Facebook & Google have become digital advertising titans.
 
My solution? Pass my bill to give outlets a chance to negotiate for fair treatment by digital platforms.
Thank you for sharing your story, @SenatorLujan. By spreading awareness of stroke symptoms, you’re helping save lives. So glad to have you back and fully recovered!
Tonight, I’m staying up late for the millions of Americans who lose sleep worrying about how they’re going to pay for their prescriptions. Let’s get this done.

Glad to join Nu-Tek to tour their new plant in Austin where they’ll be manufacturing ingredients used in medications and wellness foods. Looking forward to seeing the impact this facility has on the community, from creating good-paying jobs to spurring economic growth. https://t.co/oEpPMld8jX

Thanks to Ag Cmte Ranking Member @JohnBoozman for joining me in MN to speak with farmers, producers, conservation groups, nutrition leaders, ag researchers, and local businesses. We're focused on creating a strong, bipartisan Farm Bill that benefits farmers across the country. https://t.co/JfL1tkDkxD

Our veterans have sacrificed so much for our country. That’s why I introduced a bipartisan bill with @SenatorRounds to ensure timely and effective treatment for veterans living with PTSD. I’ll keep fighting to get it signed into law. https://t.co/vxtlEVqeVP

Our veterans have sacrificed so much for our country. That’s why I’m proud that my bipartisan legislation with @SenatorRounds to ensure effective and timely treatment for veterans living with PTSD passed the Senate. I’ll keep fighting to get it signed into law.
Many families impacted by Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders lack access to prevention, diagnostic and treatment services.

Apple’s treatment of the app Beeper Mini illustrates why we need fair and open competition in the tech sector. 

I recently led a letter with Senator Lee and Reps. Nadler and Buck urging the DOJ to investigate this potentially anticompetitive conduct.

The water treatment plant & water tower in Osakis require significant repairs to ensure residents have access to safe, quality water. The federal funding I secured will advance Osakis’s modernization project and strengthen the city’s water infrastructure.
https://t.co/0ct0G8OJm7

Primary care providers have been calling for more training resources to improve early detection, accurate diagnosis, and care of Alzheimer’s and other dementia. I’m leading bipartisan legislation with @SenCapito to deliver those tools and improve patients' quality of life.

Carbon monoxide can be deadly & this poisonous gas is far too easily released by many common household items. Thanks to @SenJohnHoeven & my bipartisan law, the MN Department of Public Safety will be able to enhance MN's alarm installation program so families can sleep safer.

The Right to IVF Act protects access to IVF and removes barriers to this treatment for families who need it. The recent vote on the Right to IVF Act demonstrates @SenateDems’s resolve to keep fighting to protect women’s health and freedom. https://t.co/rshBzbGsj1

I support the Special Diabetes Program that funds research for and delivers prevention and treatment programs to millions of Americans living with diabetes. Thank you @SenatorShaheen and @SenatorCollins for leading the bipartisan push to renew this effective program.

Today we held a nomination hearing for the USDA nominee. We must have a Secretary of Agriculture who will address the challenges facing farmers and rural families; who sees the importance of nutrition and conservation; and who will work with us on a bipartisan Farm Bill. https://t.co/LOPvSx49hm

We must ensure that every American has access to life-saving care and treatment they need. On World Cancer Day, let's recommit ourselves to expanding access to resources, research, and treatment for those impacted by cancer.

Thank you to Minnesota's Chris Engelstad and Tim Deal for testifying yesterday at the Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition & Forestry about the challenges farmers are facing.

We must do right by our farmers and the people of this country that depend on them. https://t.co/juOiRfLpmd

Thank you to everyone who joined us this morning at the Rare Disease Breakfast to mark Rare Disease Week. 

More than 30 million people in the U.S. are living with a rare disease — and we must ensure they have the resources, care, and treatment they need. https://t.co/664HUwOKUa

We were on the Senate floor taking on the billionaire budget bill until 3 AM. Got one hour of sleep and came back on a 6 AM flight to this incredible “Hands Off” rally in St. Paul. Cannot believe the crowd! https://t.co/3dCcBQY4xH

At a time when President Trump’s across-the-board tariffs and rising costs are already hurting Americans, we should not be cutting nutrition assistance.
 
I joined @SenPeterWelch, @SenatorLujan, @RonWyden, @SenJeffMerkley and @GovTinaKotek to stand up for SNAP.

.@SenGillibrand is right — our children deserve better. 
 
Cuts to SNAP mean more kids will go to sleep hungry.

When someone hears the words “you have cancer,” their only concern should be fighting it – not how they will pay for their treatment. 

We will fight Republicans every step of the way as they try to take health care away from millions of Americans.

Planned Parenthood provides lifesaving medical treatment to millions of women—from reproductive health care to cancer screenings and I strongly disagree with this decision. We will continue to fight against Republican attempts to defund Planned Parenthood in Congress.
